title: Careers In Digital Revenue | Join A Collaborative Team | Blue Triangle
markdown:
Careers

# Come help us change how the world's biggest brands think about digital revenue.

We're solving a problem that costs leading brands billions every year — and every person here has a direct impact on that mission. If that sounds like the kind of work you want to show up for, we should talk.

At Blue Triangle, you won't hear us talk about ninjas or rock stars. You will hear us talk about friction, revenue, and why the two are more connected than most companies realize. We're building something genuinely new — a platform that's changing how performance-driven organizations measure and act on digital experience. That takes curious, driven people who care about doing meaningful work and doing it well.

[See Open Positions](https://www.linkedin.com/company/blue-triangle-technologies/jobs/)

Culture & Benefits

## What it's like to work here

![lucide-palmtree](https://bluetriangle.com/hubfs/BlueTriangle_2026/Images/lucide-palmtree.svg)

Unlimited Vacation

We trust you to do great work and take the time you need. No counting days.

![lucide-heart](https://bluetriangle.com/hubfs/BlueTriangle_2026/Images/lucide-heart.svg)

Competitive Health Coverage

Comprehensive health packages because your wellbeing matters outside of work too.

![lucide-users](https://bluetriangle.com/hubfs/BlueTriangle_2026/Images/lucide-users.svg)

A Genuinely Collaborative Team

No fiefdoms. No politics. Everyone here is invested in each other's success.

![lucide-shirt](https://bluetriangle.com/hubfs/BlueTriangle_2026/Images/lucide-shirt.svg)

Casual Every Day

Wear what works for you. We care a lot more about the work than the wardrobe.

![lucide-gamepad2](https://bluetriangle.com/hubfs/BlueTriangle_2026/Images/lucide-gamepad2.svg)

We Know How to Have Fun

Team outings, friendly competition, and yes — video games.

![lucide-coffee](https://bluetriangle.com/hubfs/BlueTriangle_2026/Images/lucide-coffee.svg)

Unlimited Coffee & Soda

Fuel up however you need to do your best thinking.

## Ready to do the most interesting work of your career?

See what we're hiring for and come help us build something that matters.
